universities.name: Politecnico di Torino
universities.notes: Explicit rule for students in 5-year programmes who haven't graduated. Key question: do ENSIA's prep years count? Accepts documents in English/French/Italian/Spanish.

universities.name: University of Bologna
universities.calls: Non-EU: intake 1 ~27 Nov–14 Jan, intake 2 ~15 Jan–25 Feb; AI closed to non-EU from ~9 Apr (2026/27 dates)
universities.notes: LIKELY NO for 2027 (checked 16 Oct 2026, 2026/27 call). 1) Graduating students may apply (need ≥150 credits) but must graduate by 31 Dec of the intake year; ENSIA diploma comes 2028. 2) Grade: API ≥25.5/30 needed (≥26/30 if only 18 CS credits); ~12/20 is far below. Curriculum OK (≥18 CS credits). English B2 cert ≤3 years old. CV + Microsoft form required. Good option for 2028 only if grades allow.

universities.name: University of Padova
universities.calls: All four, 2027/28, non-EU abroad: Call 1 15 Sep–15 Nov 2026, Call 2 1 Dec 2026–1 Mar 2027 (confirmed on apply.unipd.it). One application per programme per year.
universities.notes: LIKELY NO for 2027 (checked 16 Oct 2026). Padova lets you apply before graduating, but you must complete your study cycle by 31 July 2027 (unipd.it/en/entry-title-requirements). An official certificate of a completed cycle can replace the diploma, so it only works if ENSIA certifies a completed cycle by then. All four programmes: 3-year degree (or equivalent) in the field, English B2, no stated minimum GPA (country table in a PDF), €60 fee, €2,950/yr (ISEE reductions). Data Science: 50 non-EU places. Still ask international.admission@unipd.it (task on 18 Oct).

universities.name: Sapienza University of Rome
programmes: Engineering in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence
universities.notes: From the 2026/27 call (read 14 Oct 2026): two likely blockers. 1) Non-graduated applicants from foreign universities had to obtain the degree by 19 Dec 2026, so ~Dec 2027 for us, but the ENSIA diploma comes after year 5 (2028). 2) Minimum GPA 75/100 (Data Science 80); check how 12/20 converts. Curricular credits look fine (60 CFU incl. 18 in CS). AI & Robotics also expects control theory + physics (rigid-body kinematics) and has a technical interview; Eng. in CS and AI fits better. IELTS 5.5 is enough. Contact for both: admissions@diag.uniroma1.it.

universities.name: Politecnico di Milano
universities.notes: Blocker: bachelor must be OBTAINED before enrolment (requirements page, read 14 Oct 2026). ENSIA's diploma comes after year 5, so Sept 2027 only works if ENSIA issues an official intermediate diploma after year 3 or 4 (asking scolarité 15 Oct). Algeria has no country-specific GPA minimum. Enquiry form sent 14 Oct. Apply only if they confirm eligibility. Milan is expensive.

universities.name: University of Pisa
universities.calls: Non-EU: ~Nov to ~5 Feb (2026/27: Nov 2025–5 Feb 2026); results ~9 Mar
universities.notes: LIKELY NO for 2027 (checked 16 Oct 2026, 2026/27 call). Requires a first-level bachelor degree; visa students must enrol by 31 Dec of the intake year, so the degree is needed by then. Selection on CGPA + exam fit + CV, some candidates interviewed. No CGPA minimum in the CS call (Pisa Cybersecurity requires 75% = 15/20). English B2. Tuscany DSU is generous. Contact: mcs_info@di.unipi.it. Portal: applymscenglish.unipi.it.

universities.name: University of Trento
universities.notes: LIKELY NO for 2027 (checked 16 Oct 2026). Final-year students can apply with an enrolment certificate, but non-EU students must send the degree certificate by ~30 June of the intake year (2025/26: 30 June 2025). English B2. Option for 2028.
